title: Disk Watchdog
summary: A background check every 10 minutes that shrinks huge Claude temp logs and cleans old session temp and old backups.
details: A scheduled check runs every 10 minutes and at logon: it shrinks Claude temp logs over 1 GB and force-stops the programs holding them (never claude.exe or explorer.exe), deletes session temp older than 3 days and backups older than 90 days, and sends a Telegram alert (only if set up) under 20 GB free disk. It suits PCs where Claude temp and logs grow large. It adds a PowerShell script and a hidden VBS launcher, plus a task you register; no network except the optional alert.
machine_steps: Dry run first in PowerShell 7: run ~/.claude/tools/disk-watchdog.ps1 with -DryRun -SweepNow; the last line must start with "run ok".

Register a scheduled task named "Claude Disk Watchdog" (no admin needed): it runs wscript.exe //B //Nologo on ~/.claude/tools/disk-watchdog-hidden.vbs, every 10 minutes and at logon, for the current user, with a 5-minute time limit, one run at a time, also on battery. If a task with the same action exists, update it instead of adding a second.

Tell the person what it does: it force-stops programs that hold Claude temp logs over 1 GB (never claude.exe or explorer.exe), deletes session temp older than 3 days and ~/.claude/backups folders older than 90 days (this includes the install backup), and sends a Telegram alert under 20 GB free disk only if Telegram is set up.
risk: A scheduled task runs every 10 minutes and at logon; it can force-stop programs holding big Claude logs and delete old temp and backup folders. No network except the optional Telegram alert.
